newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanghai Industrial in share issue.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Industrial in share issue.

text.p: Shanghai Industrial Holdings Ltd said it would issue 162 million new shares at HK$19.50 per share to raise HK$3.159 billion and make investments in and acquisitions of various automotive, infrastructure, food and commercial interests for an aggregate HK$2.7 billion.

In a statement on Sunday, Shanghai Industrial said its immediate holding company, Shanghai Investment Holdings Ltd (SIH), would place 56 million existing shares in the company with independent investors at HK$19.50 each and subsequently subscribe for 72 million new shares at the same price.
The placing has been underwritten by Peregrine Capital Ltd and Morgan Stanley & Co International Ltd.
Shanghai Industrial also said SIH would subscribe for a second issue of 90 million new shares at the same price.
Gross proceeds of the first issue amount to HK$1.404 billion before expenses, and those of the second to HK$1.755 billion.

Shanghai Industrial said it agreed with state-owned Shanghai Automotive Co Ltd to form an equal joint venture, Shanghai Huizhong Automotive JV, which is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobile components and spare parts.
Subsequent to formation of the venture, its total initial investment and registered capital was increased to US$271.08 million and US$108.43 million respectively.

The company said it would apply the proceeds of the first new share issue and HK$150 million in internal resources to finance the agreggate consideration of about HK$1.542 billion for the Huizhong investment.

Shanghai Industrial further said it would acquire from Shanghai Industrial Investment (Holdings) Co Ltd (SIIC) the issued share capital of and shareholders' loans owing by various infrastructure, automotive, food and commerce enterprises.
SIIC wholly owns SIH, Shanghai Industrial's holding company.
The company will acquire SI Infrastructure Holdings Ltd, SI Automobile Development Holdings ltd, SI Food Products Holdings ltd, and SI Commerce Holdings Ltd.

SI Infrastructure holds 50.2 percent of Shanghai Yanan Road Elevated Road Development Co Ltd, which is engaged in the construction, operation, management and maintenance of the western and eastern sections of the Yanan Road Elevated Highway.
The remainder is held by Shanghai City Construction Investment Development General Corp.

SI Automobile holds 30 percent of Shanghai Transportation Electric JV, which is engaged in the manufacture, distribution and sale of automobile components. The remainder is held by state-owned Shanghai City Motor Car Co.

SI Food holds 50 percent of Shanghai Bright Dairy and Food Co Ltd, which will be engaged in the manufacture, distribution and sale of dairy products and non-carbonated drinks. The remainder is held by state-owned Shanghai City Dairy Co.
SI Commerce holds 51 percent of Shanghai Orient Shopping Centre Ltd. The remainder is held by state-owned Shanghai Yibai (Holdings) Co Ltd.

Shanghai Industrial said it would apply the proceeds of the second new share issue to finance the agreggate consideration of about HK$1.2 billion for the SIIC acquisitions, with the surplus going to general working capital.

Following the placement in existing shares, representing about 10.5 percent of issued share capital, and the two new issues, SIH will hold about 65.1 percent of Shanghai Industrial, the same proportion as before the deals.
The deals are conditional on shareholders and authorities approving various relevant portions.
